rv.q: This remains a masterclass in how to woo an audience.

Given that Spacey excels at complex, Machiavellian characters, this liberal crusader isn't the most natural fit; there's a slightly disconcerting sense that we're seeing House of Cards' Frank Underwood develop a social conscience.

cn.t: Spacey delivers a mesmerising performance as the crusading lawyer, though the 41-year-old script shows its age with an unsophisticated, overly brisk treatment of Darrow's courtroom triumphs.
